title: Go/no-go pilots for angle A (genotype-specific phenology-aligned exposure) and angle B (evolutionary x trial environment bridge)
status: FROZEN - thresholds below must not be changed after any result is seen; deviations must be declared, not silently applied

common.unit_of_evaluation: hybrid mean within environment (average of plots of the same Hybrid in the same Env)
common.test_env_inclusion: Env in test year with >=30 genotyped hybrids having yield
common.primary_metric: within-environment Pearson r between predicted and observed hybrid means, averaged with equal weight over all test envs pooled across the three test years
secondary_metrics: same metrics restricted to hybrids never phenotyped in training years (new hybrids)
common.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over test environments, 2000 resamples, seed 20260928; 95% percentile CI of the model difference
common.genotype_processing: 2,425 SNPs from 5_Genotype_Data_All_2014_2025_Hybrids.vcf coded 0/1/2 (alt dosage), MAF>=0.05 among G2F hybrids, missing -> marker mean; PCA fitted on all genotyped hybrids (no phenotypes used); K=30 PCs for interaction terms
common.response_centering: training response = hybrid-mean yield minus env mean (env main effects cannot affect within-env r)
common.model_class: ridge regression; features standardized on training data; penalty chosen from log grid 10^-2..10^5 by holding out the LAST training year as validation, then refit on all training years; no information from the test year is used anywhere except weather of the test environment (weather is treated as known, CV0-style)
common.gdd: daily GDD = max(0, (min(Tmax,30)+max(Tmin,10))/2 - 10) using T2M_MAX/T2M_MIN from 4_Training_Weather_Data; accumulated from env median planting date
window_variables: mean VPD (kPa) from T2M and RH2M via Tetens

A.hypothesis: Aligning environmental exposure to each hybrid's own (genomically predicted) silking time adds predictive information for yield in new years beyond environment-level alignment and beyond a linear maturity x environment interaction.

A1_detectability.what: genotype-specific EC_ij aligned at OBSERVED silking (hybrid mean silking GDD within env); within-environment variance share = mean within-env variance / total variance, per EC

A2_phenology_predictability.what: ridge on SNPs predicts hybrid silking GDD (target = hybrid mean of plot-level silking GDD over training envs); evaluate within-env Pearson r with observed silking GDD in each test env
A2_phenology_predictability.fail_action: A3 still runs; flag that predicted alignment is noisy

A3_models.M0: SNP main effects + (PC1..30 x EC_env) where EC_env uses windows anchored at the env-level anchor = mean predicted silking GDD of the hybrids in that env
A3_models.M0plus: M0 + predicted maturity (z) x EC_env (21 terms)
A3_models.M1plus: M0plus + dEC_ij main (21) + (PC1..30 x dEC_ij), dEC_ij = EC_ij(windows anchored at hybrid's predicted silking GDD) - EC_env; in training years predicted maturity = in-sample genomic prediction from the same training fit
A3_models.M1shuffle: as M1plus but predicted maturity permuted among hybrids within each env before computing EC_ij (10 permutation replicates, seeds 1..10; report mean)
A3_models.M1oracle: as M1plus but EC_ij anchored at OBSERVED hybrid-mean silking in both train and test (upper bound; uses test-year phenotype, flagged as leakage by construction)

A3_decision.GO: mean r(M1plus) - r(M0plus) >= 0.01 AND bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND r(M1plus) - r(M1shuffle) CI lower bound > 0
A3_decision.WEAK_GO: CI lower bound > 0 for M1plus - M0plus but point estimate < 0.01 (and beats M1shuffle)
A3_decision.NO_GO: CI of M1plus - M0plus includes 0 or is negative, OR oracle headroom r(M1oracle) - r(M0plus) < 0.01
A3_decision.note: A1 no_go overrides to NO_GO on G2F; conclusions apply to G2F only (narrow within-env maturity range, median within-env silking SD about 3 days)

B.hypothesis: A genome-inferred 'adaptive environment' learned from georeferenced landraces carries information about G2F hybrids' reaction to trial temperature beyond population structure, and improves forward-year prediction.

B0_data.requirement: public genotype matrix of georeferenced Mexican/American maize landraces (e.g., CIMMYT SeeD GBS, B73 v4 coordinates or liftable) + origin environment (He et al. 2024 GitHub Mexi_landrace_env.csv, passport coordinates + WorldClim, or equivalent published table)
B0_data.blocked: if not obtainable after requesting network access where needed -> BLOCKED (not NO_GO); no simulated or substitute data allowed

B1_overlap.pass: >=300 SNPs matched by v4 chromosome+position and alleles (allowing strand flip for non-palindromic SNPs), MAF>=0.05 in both panels

targets: temperature (growing-season mean if available, else annual mean bio1)
B2_gea_signal.model: ridge on overlap SNPs; spatially blocked CV = GroupKFold(5) with groups = 2x2 degree lat/lon cells
B2_gea_signal.pass: Pearson r >= 0.4 for at least one pre-declared target

B3_transfer.score: projection of each G2F hybrid with the full-landrace ridge model for the chosen target (temperature if it passed B2, else the best-passing target)
B3_transfer.domain_pass: >=50% of G2F hybrid scores inside the 1-99% quantile range of landrace cross-validated predictions
B3_transfer.structure_pass: R^2 of score ~ tester (Hybrid_Parent2) dummies + top 10 G2F PCs <= 0.8

B4_gxe_association.slopes: for hybrids with >=5 envs in 2014-2018, random-regression/empirical-Bayes-shrunk slope of hybrid-mean yield on env temperature (env mean T2M_MAX in the env-level W2 flowering window as defined in common)
B4_gxe_association.statistic: partial Pearson r between B3 score and slope controlling for tester dummies + top 10 G2F PCs
B4_gxe_association.null_primary: 1,000 same-size random projections: landrace ridge coefficients permuted across the overlap SNPs, re-projected, statistic recomputed
B4_gxe_association.null_secondary: 1,000 permutations of landrace environment labels (retrain + reproject), reported if compute allows
B4_gxe_association.pass: |partial r| >= 0.1 AND two-sided empirical p < 0.05 against primary null

B5_forward_gain.model: M0plus from A + (score_z x EC_env) 21 terms; same splits/metric/bootstrap as A
B5_forward_gain.GO: gain over M0plus >= 0.01 with CI lower bound > 0 AND beats the coefficient-permuted-score control

reporting_rules: report every gate outcome including failures
any departure from this spec (e.g., different landrace source, fewer permutations) must be listed as a deviation with reason
results frozen as JSON with sha256 of inputs and outputs
